test_title: PYST 39: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph shows the number of appeared candidates and passed candidates (in hundreds) in a test from 5 different institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e282759b0f987307114cb35fbea7eb4b5e64a1780a91d15664a31e2e5ba6d035.png] 

What is the average number (in hundreds) of candidates to have passed per institution?
solution:
Concept used:

Average = Sum of all the values/Total no. of values

Calculation:

According to the question,

Candidate passed = A + B + C + D + E

The values are given in hundreds:

Candidate passed = 1200 + 2000 + 800 + 2600 + 1800 = 8400

Average = 8400/5 = 1680

**∴ The average number (in hundreds) of candidates to have passed per institution is 16.80.**
